definitions.explanation: A freshwater trout with a pinkish stripe along its side, native to North America and brought to Japan in the late nineteenth century. Widely farmed and stocked in fishing ponds, and usually eaten salt-grilled.

examples.japanese: ニジマス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{釣|つ}った→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧。
⟦{釣|つ}った→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧ニジマス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧にした。
examples.english: We salt-grilled the rainbow trout we caught right there on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}→釣り堀：27615_tsuribori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ニジマス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放|はな}してある→放す：29986_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}ども⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{釣|つ}れる→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧。
examples.english: Farmed rainbow trout are released in this fishing pond, so even children can catch them easily.

notes:
Written {虹鱒|にじます}: ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧ (rainbow) and {鱒|ます} (trout), from the colored band on its side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニジマス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled rainbow trout
- ニジマス{釣|つ}り: rainbow trout fishing
- ⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ニジマス: farmed rainbow trout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧: salmon — a sea-run relative; trout and salmon are not sharply separated in Japanese
- ⟦{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}→淡水魚：28709_tansuigyo⟧: freshwater fish — the category it belongs to
